author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Reveal Trailer for The Snackbar at the End of the World, the hit action-adventure developed by Snackbar Studio. Players will thrive as a chef in a fantasy 1960s Italy to save the family's struggling restaurant from closing for good. Make delicious dishes across a narrative-driven adventure in The Snackbar at the End of the World, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Snackbar at the End of the World - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out gameplay from King in the Mountain in this launch trailer for the dwarven resource-management incremental game. King in the Mountain is available now on Steam.

In King in the Mountain, you can't rebuild a fallen kingdom on gold alone. You need dwarves to mine it, workshops to process it, equipment to make the next expedition worthwhile, and a settlement that can keep it all running.

In King in the Mountain, a handful of workers and a nearly empty treasury are the beginnings of an ever-growing operation - if you manage your resources well.
title: King in the Mountain - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a deep dive into the gameplay of Prinny Party: Going Overboard! in this latest trailer for the party game. In Prinny Party: Going Overboard!, you'll move around the board, buy weapons, and upgrade facilities, working together...until you don't! Prinny Party: Going Overboard! is available now on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PC (Steam).
title: Prinny Party: Going Overboard! - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

description: Don't miss the Console Launch Trailer for Leaf Blower Co., a leaf-blowing simulation game developed by LifT Games. Leaf Blower Co. is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S, with the game being available now on PC (Steam).

description: Check out gameplay from Echofall in this trailer for the upcoming sci-fi FPS power fantasy where the rules of reality become yours to break. description: Watch the Launch Trailer for Wilderdark, a first-person survival horror action-adventure game developed by Team Junkfish. Wilderdark is available now on PC (Steam).

description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Choomby, an online action-adventure game developed by Cyberstars Entertainment. Players will find themselves being hunted by each other as bees and spiders across diverse maps, modes to reign victorious, and traps to avoid. Choomby is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Choomby - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Cursed Words gets a new trailer showcasing its upcoming DLC, The Madness of Michael. Check out the Cursed Words: The Madness of Michael release date trailer for a peek at what's coming in this DLC for the roguelike game. Cursed Words: The Madness of Michael DLC will be available on Steam on November 25, 2026.

In Cursed Words, it all starts quite simple: use tiles on the board to make words, aiming to score enough points each round to earn some money and keep your progress going. But as the score targets get higher and bosses with more punishing abilities begin to appear, winning will definitely require a rather creative definition of what qualifies as a “word”. 

Leave letters behind as you combine chess pieces, numbers, poker hands and a plethora of wild cards to break the rules of language as the game evolves into a roguelike beyond words.
title: Cursed Words: The Madness of Michael - Official DLC Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Tanuki: Pon's Summer, an open-world life-simulation adventure game developed by Denkiworks. Players will take on a part-time job at the Post Office to deliver packages across town, meet the locals, and restore the shrine before Summer's end. Tanuki: Pon's Summer is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam).
title: Tanuki: Pon's Summer - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Launch Trailer for After the Wane, a visual novel adventure game developed by Nova-box. Players will explore a narrative full of artistic ambitions, mysteries, and destiny while making key dialogue choices to shape the story ahead. After the Wane is available now for PC (Steam).
title: After the Wane - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Herdling is available now on Nintendo Switch 2, with a free upgrade to owners of the original Switch version of the game. It is also available on Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store. Watch the Herdling Nintendo Switch 2 launch trailer for this adventure game to see gameplay and more of its world.

Herdling follows a young girl named Via who shepherds mysterious animals called Calicorns through a dangerous mountain path, encountering surprising threats and environmental challenges along the way. Forge an unbreakable bond with your pack in this emotional tale as you ascend the mountain and attempt to keep your herd intact.
title: Herdling - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into Worms: Galactic Tactics in this new trailer for the upcoming 3D turn-based tactical roguelike game. Learn about combat in fully destructible arenas, weapons, how to upgrade and reinvent classic Worms weapons, and more. In Worms: Galactic Tactics, climb the ranks of the Galactic Gauntlet and take down the magnificent Emperor Flugg! 

Worms: Galactic Tactics will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2027.
title: Worms: Galactic Tactics - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

title: Dreadmoor - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Time to make some CRAZY money! 

The meter is running and the final destination is officially locked in: welcome to India! Get your exclusive first look at the final international map coming to Crazy Taxi World Tour in this IGN premiere.

Joining the West Coast, Germany, Japan, and Brazil, India rounds out the 5-map globe-trotting roster. This massive new destination is perfect for exploring by taxi. Tear through three distinct environments: the bustling City, the scenic Countryside, and the chaotic Industrial zones. Find insane jumps, massive shortcuts, and your next big fare.

#CrazyTaxi #CrazyTaxiWorldTour #IGN #Gaming #Sega #Trailer
title: Crazy Taxi World Tour - Exclusive India Map Reveal Trailer

description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Social Net, a beach adventure game developed by The Social Net Team. Players will embody an energetic clownfish on a grand adventure beyond the water. Collect humans from the beach and bring them to the depths of the ocean in Social Net, coming soon to PC (Steam).

See how the biomes turn from gray boxes to fully designed worlds in Subnautica 2, available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Subnautica 2 - Official Voyage to Early Access 2: Designing the Deep Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Payday 3 x Ghost Recon Crimebond teaser trailer for a peek at the upcoming collaboration. Legendary Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon gear and weapons are coming to Payday 3 in a new Crimebond, available November 24, 2026. 

Payday 3 is available now on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5)
title: Payday 3 x Ghost Recon - Official Crimebond Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Sol Mates gets a chaotic new trailer and a release date. Check out the latest Sol Mates trailer for this upcoming roguelike co-op party game for one to four players. Sol Mates will be available on PC via Steam on January 26, 2027.

In Sol Mates, players run a scrappy interstellar odd jobs agency, crewing a spaceship through pirate ambushes, black holes, and bizarre client requests. Crewmates scramble to work across various stations, from loading guns, to charging batteries, and putting out the occasional fires. Together, players need to keep the ship in one piece to become the galaxy's ultimate gig workers. Between missions, the crew votes on story decisions and chart their course through space, so no two runs tell quite the same tale.
title: Sol Mates - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Haul Yeah!, a retro delivery-driving sandbox game developed by Moonjump. Players will deliver cargo across a mountainous county alone or with friends. Build the business, deal with real physics, and attain better parts for the job ahead. Haul Yeah! is launching on December 16 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Haul Yeah! - Official Gameplay Trailer

description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Emery Hearts, an action-adventure RPG developed by Haishō Interactive. title: Emery Hearts - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon is available now in Early Access on PC via Steam. Watch the launch trailer for Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon, a ski resort building and management simulator game. The launch trailer showcases gameplay and more as you build resorts from scratch. It's time to hit the slopes.

From designing mountain trails and terrain parks to managing resort facilities and keeping guests happy, players can build their dream ski resort and create a destination worth visiting. With real mountains from around the world, dynamic weather, and realistic snow simulation, every playthrough offers a chance to create something different in Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon.
title: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

description:

In this upcoming sim game, you can build a traveling business in a vibrant fantasy world, buy and sell goods, discover magical treasures and grow a humble market cart into a thriving merchant caravan. You can set out alone or team up with up to three friends in online co-op. 

Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator will be available in Steam Early Access on January 21, 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

description:
